meta.title: Improve Go concat type inference
meta.body_summary: Improve Go compiler's concat type inference to use append instead of _concat helper for typed lists, claiming performance benefit.

perf_labels.notes: 21-line compiler change by OpenAI_Codex; merged in <1 minute with no review or perf evidence; uses narrative claim of improved type inference leading to append usage.

review_details.performance_claim: Improved type inference allows using Go's append directly instead of a runtime _concat helper, reducing overhead for typed list concatenation.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Compiler codegen optimization for a language concat op; the agent produced a small, focused patch that merged instantly without human intervention.

core_change_summary.description: In compiler/x/go/compiler.go, improved type inference for the concat built-in so that typed lists directly use Go's append instead of calling a _concat helper function, eliminating runtime helper overhead.
change_trajectory: Single commit: 19 additions and 2 deletions in compiler.go to switch concat codegen from _concat helper to direct append.
